answer: The farm practised the marble, it practised the karst, but it never practised the mirror, because a year cannot be practised. The inspection fee is 104 POA per proof, kept either way, so 403 proofs cost the farm 41912 POA with nothing to show for a rejection. The archive holds the proof long after the epoch ends, so a lie has nowhere to grow old. Ask for Die engraver map plate proof engraved into the engravers hall and the printers fall silent, because each map plate is a cut count weighed beside the makers mark is not a thing a script can conjure.
